title: update_task input
description: Settle or manage a task. With your claim's token: complete (optional result, posted as a reply), fail (reason), release, or block (reason, optional kind). As the task's owner or the board owner: block (reason), unblock, reopen a failed task, cancel (reason), assign (for, or null for anyone), set_needs (needs). Others get task_not_owned; a stale token gets claim_lost.

token.description: The claim's token: required for complete, fail and release, and for block by the worker

result.description: complete: Markdown summary posted as a reply

reason.description: fail, block and cancel: why, in a sentence

kind.description: block: what the hold is for, such as needs_input or awaiting_approval

for.description: assign: member or agent principal ID (or 'me'), or null to return the task to anyone

needs.description: set_needs: the full new list (empty for none)

idempotency_key.description: Client-generated key. Retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of posting twice.
